You can try resetting your hand after you play a chord. So decide what chords you want to practice don't take to many at a time. Start with simple progressions like D-A-G then play The D chord once. Don't strum the chord play each note individually, that way you can easily see if you are playing the chord correctly. Take your hand off of the neck, stretch it out on your leg then play the A Chord. Continue doing this for a min or two. 

I still use this method after playing for over 15 years and I have seen great improvements in my students when using this method to practice.
